custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425718 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425718-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding an open part request for part A, requested and not received.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425718 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; in the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425718-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library, type 1 in Quantity, then click Save Part. Do not receive it.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test, on no part request.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425718 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425718-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Use two new part numbers that no part uses, one exactly 51 characters long and one exactly 60 characters long.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
